title: Silver Rewards Card: Understanding Your Included Travel Insurance Coverage
summary: Explains the Silver Rewards Card’s included travel insurance: per-trip coverage limit up to $15,000 across up to 5 covered incident categories (e.g., cancellation/interruption, delays, lost/delayed baggage). Coverage applies only if you charge the travel fare in full to the card and follows policy terms, exclusions, and required documentation.
faqs: What is the per-trip coverage limit for the Silver Rewards Card travel insurance?
Which types of incidents are covered (up to how many categories)?
Do I need to charge the travel fare to my Silver Rewards Card for coverage to apply?
What expenses are typically covered when a covered event occurs (e.g., cancellation, delays, baggage delays)?
What reasons or situations are typically not covered?
What documents and proof do I need to submit a claim (receipts and notices)?
